name: Jammin' Jars

features.name: Jam Jar wilds
features.description: Jars move around the grid and their multiplier increases by 1 each time they are part of a win.

features.name: Rainbow feature
features.description: Can add giant fruit symbols to the grid.

review:
The fruit cluster game that made moving multiplier wilds famous. Jam Jar wilds hop around the grid, and in free spins they stick around and keep raising their multipliers – so a bonus with several jars can grow huge.

Still one of the most fun cluster slots out there, with a Rainbow feature that can drop giant fruit. High volatility, 20,000x max and a strong 96.83% RTP. The demo opens on Push Gaming's site.
